title: Native ordinary open tensor counit is invertible
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell, and an open immersion j:X -> Z of schemes in universe u. For ordinary modules M on X and N on Z, the counit of the actual native open-extension adjunction, evaluated at the ordinary tensor of j_! M with N, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; the projection-formula isomorphism is the inverse of the native extension counit.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient sequence site with the product of the open pro-etale slice and the coefficient index, and transport the direct-sum extension-by-zero construction along the constant-section comparison to the actual native extension adjunction.

Apply the localized ordinary extension/tensor projection formula of Tag 0E8I on each coefficient quotient. The direct-sum generators and balanced tensor maps commute with every horizontal quotient transition, so the resulting comparison descends to the sequence site and is exactly the native counit. Its generator calculation gives both inverse composites.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0E8I, ordinary projection-formula counit calculation transported to the coefficient sequence site.
